notes: Paper-guided reconstruction, not the original FunBO implementation or a paper-result reproduction. No dedicated official FunBO source repository was verified.
AppendixC.1 Table1 domains, grid cardinalities, fixed zero-mean RBF GP lengthscales/variance/noise are preserved; one initial worst grid point and30 acquisition decisions follow Figures8/9.

Original grid/seed not published in inspected sources: scipy.stats.qmc.Sobol(scramble=True,seed=0) creates a fixed dyadic sequence, truncated to the exact paper grid size. The returned grid and objective SHA256 values identify it.

Reported score is normalized simple regret relative to the same discrete grid optimum; raw regret and trials-to-grid-optimum are retained. It is not error relative to an unknown continuous optimum or the two-term FunSearch training reward.

GP prediction is implemented with SciPy Cholesky, including Gaussian likelihood variance as in GPy.predict; bounded numerical jitter, if needed, is reported. Candidate returns a validated integer index from predictive mean/variance arrays and incumbent.
The seed is expected improvement with the paper Figure8 interface; no discovered FunBO AF or MetaBO policy result is claimed.
